cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-help-stays-in-reader
cases.purpose: Native help keys and the public help-pane request share a searchable in-buffer modal, preserve reading state and restore focus after layered Escape.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-switching-books-keeps-separate-progress
cases.purpose: Switching between books preserves independent chapter positions and never attributes the previous book's progress to the next.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-library-query-sort-and-pages
cases.purpose: Query and author filters reset pagination and every matching book remains reachable in the requested order.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-preferences-persist-and-reject-invalid-options
cases.purpose: Preferences persist across sessions and invalid mixed options leave state unchanged.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-root-keys-own-the-canvas
cases.purpose: The reader's root keys beat the renderer's map, t repaints the canvas beyond the page in the new theme, and q closes the reader.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-arrows-reach-the-page
cases.purpose: With no control focused, arrows turn the page from anywhere in the reader and extend a keyboard selection instead of moving focus.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-navigation-panes-and-return-position
cases.purpose: Mounted navigation dialogs and settings open and close through public actions and keys while preserving the reading page and jump history.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-mounted-styled-pages-and-final-page
cases.purpose: Mounted one- and two-column turns preserve heading and annotation faces, render the final partial page, and continue through the keyboard after resizing.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-headless-session-starts-on-shelf
cases.purpose: A session built without a buffer starts on the shelf and needs no window or backend.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-scan-imports-into-the-store
cases.purpose: Scanning stores the discovered book and opening imports its chapters and lines.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-pages-turn-and-chapters-advance
cases.purpose: Page turns move by one page and crossing the last page opens the next chapter.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-selection-annotate-and-note
cases.purpose: A selection becomes an annotation that can change style and carry a thought, then be deleted.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-progress-is-restored
cases.purpose: Saving stores chapter and line and a new session resumes exactly there.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-search-finds-and-selects
cases.purpose: Search finds a phrase across chapters, jumps to it and selects the match.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-reflow-keeps-position
cases.purpose: A column change re-wraps the chapter and keeps the reading offset.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-export-notes
cases.purpose: Exporting writes quotations and thoughts of the book as Markdown.

cases.name: etaf-reader-tests-shelf-filters-use-state
cases.purpose: Shelf filters read the stored reading state instead of a second copy.
